package.name: neo_sources
package.description:
Owns /sources/set and publishes /sources/state: which of the two backends (the Pi hardware or the admin panel browser) is live for the camera, the microphone and the speaker.
The backend nodes gate themselves on the state this publishes rather than being started and stopped, so a crash here cannot leave a microphone hot.
Also the mux for the browser: the panel's camera, microphone and speaker topics reach the graph only while their stream is switched to webapp.
